N01.text: Far out in the unfashionable suburbs of the Milky Way, there orbits a small, damp, blue planet.

N02.text: For three hundred thousand years, it was run by a species of clever apes, who invented fire, the wheel, democracy... and videos of cats falling off things.

N03.text: By galactic standards, they were doing... fine.

N05.text: The Blorxians are famous throughout the galaxy for three things: their invincible war fleet, their deep love of paperwork... and General Gafoop.

G01.text: Lieutenant Blorp! Scan the planet. Find me its dominant species!

C01.text: Analysis complete. The large woolly quadrupeds are fed, groomed, sheltered and chauffeured by hairless bipeds.

C02.text: The bipeds wear the woolly ones' hair as a sign of devotion.

G02.text: It's obvious! The fluffy ones are the masters. The hairless ones are their servants!

B02.text: Sir, the hairless ones built the cities, the satellites, the...

G03.text: Servants, Blorp! Do the fluffy ones lift a single hoof? No! That... is power.

N06.text: Under the Intergalactic Code of Conquest, an invader may exterminate any species on a planet... except the dominant one.

N07.text: After all, somebody has to sign the surrender.

G04.text: Exterminate the servants! Do not harm the fluffy ones!

N08.text: The invasion took nine minutes. The sheep did not notice.

A01.text: General Gafoop. The Galactic Bureau of Conquest has reviewed your invasion.

A02.text: Please present the dominant species, so that it may sign the surrender.

A04.text: General, you have exterminated the dominant species. Your invasion is illegal.

A05.text: Unless, of course, the sheep can be shown to be more advanced than the humans were.

G06.text: Easy! How advanced were the humans?

A06.text: Space travel. Nuclear power. The microwave burrito.

A07.text: General Gafoop, you are hereby exiled to Earth, until the sheep surpass the humans. Good luck.

G08.text: Right! Listen up, troops! Today, you are livestock. Tomorrow... you are a civilisation!
